SubFlows.Title: Set Table Checkbox Inside Active Row

Value.Value: This subflow helps to set Table checkbox fields in active row inside a table.

Retrieving aria-checked attribute to validate if checkbox is checked or unchecked. aria-checked attribute returns either true or false. true corresponds to checkbox is checked and false corresponds to checkbox is unchecked.
Comparing aria-checked attribute. if attribute value is false, checkbox is not checked yet. if attribute value is true checkbox is already checked.
Comparing aria-checked attribute. if attribute value is true, checkbox is checked. if attribute value is false checkbox is already unchecked.
Value should be either True Or False.
A switch case to handle Value input.When Value = True, Set check for the checkbox. When Value = False, Set uncheck for the checkbox.
The parent node of a active row is known as the "Section Name" or "FastTab Name". This distinction is useful when navigating multiple tables in the UI.
